data.one_liner: Auto-generated client libraries for accessing Google APIs.
data.what_it_does: Provides auto-generated client libraries for accessing various Google APIs described through the API discovery service. It allows developers to interact with services like Firebase, Analytics, and BigQuery directly from Dart and Flutter applications.
use_when: You need to interact with Google APIs that are currently in beta stage from Dart or Flutter.
You want strongly-typed clients for Google backend and cloud services.
avoid_when: You need stable, production-ready Google APIs (use package:googleapis instead).
The specific Google API you need has been removed or promoted to stable.
strengths: Provides programmatic access to a wide range of beta Google APIs.
Automatically generated types and requests matching API specs.
weaknesses: Beta APIs may change or be removed in future versions.
Large package surface area due to many auto-generated clients.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the package to dependencies and using proper authentication tokens (OAuth2) with _discoveryapis_commons.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer making custom REST requests to Google APIs manually instead of using a generated client library.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a robust HTTP client with interceptors for communicating with Google backend services.
